items.approach: Port common.h to SYCL 2020 header: cuda_check/cublasCheck to SYCL exception handling, setup_main cudaSetDevice/cudaGetDeviceProperties/cublasCreate/cublasLtCreate/cudaMalloc workspace to sycl::queue device selection plus oneMath queue and USM workspace, ceil_div/Packed128/load128/store128/load128cs/store128cs/store128cg to aligned struct with sycl::vec and plain USM loads (drop streaming hints), warpReduceSum/blockReduce to sub-group shuffles plus sycl::local_accessor and joint_reduce, floatX/floatN/CUBLAS_LOWP selection to sycl::ext::oneapi::bfloat16 alias, WARP_SIZE/__CUDA_ARCH__/MAX_1024_THREADS_BLOCKS/__launch_bounds__ to queried sub-group and work-group limits, memcpy_convert/validate_result/benchmark_kernel cudaMemcpy/cudaEvent to queue memcpy/memset and SYCL profiling events.

library_mappings.notes: cublas_handle, cublasSgemm setup and CUBLAS_TF32_TENSOR_OP_MATH map to oneMath BLAS queue and compute mode; no cublasHandle_t, use SYCL queue
no direct equivalent: gemm plus a hand-written epilogue (bias, GELU); cublaslt_workspace and LtMatmulDesc map to oneMath gemm_batch plus separate SYCL epilogue kernel

risks: WARP_SIZE 32u: SYCL sub-group size is not guaranteed to be 32; query sub_group::get_local_range or request reqd_sub_group_size and keep WarpSize as constant only for sizing
warp_shuffle __shfl_xor_sync/__shfl_down_sync in warpReduceSum: use sycl::shift_group_left / permute_group_by_xor / select_from_group plus joint_reduce, do not assume sub-group size 32
shared_memory __shared__ float shared_val[WARP_SIZE] in blockReduce: use sycl::local_accessor<float>
streaming loads __ldcs/__stcs/__stcg/__ldcg: no SYCL equivalent, use plain USM load/store
bf16 __nv_bfloat16 and ENABLE_BF16/ENABLE_FP16 floatX/floatN: use sycl::ext::oneapi::bfloat16 and sycl::half
streams_events cudaEvent/cudaStream in benchmark_kernel: use sycl::event and queue profiling, queue memset for L2 flush buffer
inline launch control __CUDA_ARCH__, MAX_1024_THREADS_BLOCKS, __launch_bounds__: query device max work-group size, no arch-specific code

plan.summary: Migrate 22 CUDA files via SYCL 2020 in dependency order: common scaffolding first, then 10 Tier1 plain kernels, then 5 Tier2 sub-group/cooperative/bf16 designs, then 7 Tier3 oneMath/oneDNN/oneCCL replacements with NCCL last; each item verified by its existing CPU reference and validate_result tolerances.
